resources.string: Which ships sail, and what\'s left to fit out
myCar leaves the helm now. With the cable, unplug it and plug it back in to come back aboard.
Calls and shanties play over Bluetooth, but your phone isn\'t connected to the car. Connect it here or from the car\'s Bluetooth menu.
myCar needs Bluetooth and nearby Wi-Fi access to board wirelessly.
myCar is switched off aboard (Rigging, \"Use myCar aboard\").
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on, then tap Board wirelessly again.
Your phone isn\'t paired with anything yet. Pair it with the ship first.
Ship not on the roster? Pair it with your phone first.
Most cars work. Starting around 2020, some cars added newer security standards that reject myCar\'s certificate, and myCar can\'t come aboard those cars.

myCar opens by itself when the ship connects. The first time with the cable, Android asks which app to open: choose myCar and tap Always. For wireless, pair the phone with the ship first, then tap Board wirelessly on Home.
With a VPN, leave myCar out of it to board wirelessly.

Inside a VPN, Android keeps myCar off the ship\'s Wi-Fi. Leave myCar out in the VPN app (in Tailscale: Settings, App split tunneling), turn the VPN off for the voyage, or use the cable. With \"Block connections without VPN\" on, Android blocks myCar outside the VPN too: turn that off in Android\'s VPN settings.
Repel unknown callers before they ring.
Stop the audio prompt each voyage.
Connect the phone to a computer with USB debugging on, and run this once. Skip it and you accept Android\'s question with one tap each time you set sail.
Android hides what notifications say while it shares audio. Run this too, and myCar lifts that only while shanties go to the car.
myCar uses %1$s from now on. Connect to the car again: plug the cable back in, or board wirelessly.
myCar uses the next certificate from now on. Connect to the car again: plug the cable back in, or board wirelessly.
To use the public ones instead, remove yours in Rigging, under Certificate.
Cast off from the car to install. Installing closes myCar.
Hauled aboard. Android asks before it installs.
Haul it aboard now. Android asks before it installs.
myCar scans the horizon once a day
Version %1$s is in the hold, ready to install
Refit in the myCar app or from GitHub
Not enough room in the phone\'s hold for the refit. Free some, then try again.
Hauling aboard stopped. Check the connection, then try again.
GitHub didn\'t send the refit (code %1$d). Try again later.
Hauling aboard stopped early. Try again.
The download came aboard damaged. Try again.
These free apps sail at myCar\'s helm. Each button opens the app\'s page on GitHub.
Nothing in the log yet. Lines appear here live while a voyage is under way.
No earlier ship\'s logs yet. Each time myCar sets sail, it begins a new one.
Waiting for a frame on the horizon…
myCar is free, with no ads and no tracking. If it gets you under way, your backing keeps the ship afloat.
Android\'s question to send the sound through myCar was turned down, so the car gets no shanties.
